items.prompt: An event has event time 10:00:04 and availability 10:00:06. Can a decision at 10:00:05 use it in this replay contract?

options.text: Yes, because its event time is earlier
Yes, if its future price improves the strategy
options.why: Performance does not authorize future information.

options.text: Yes, whenever the arrays have equal lengths
options.why: Shape matching does not resolve time availability.

options.text: No, because it was not yet available
options.why: The decision must exclude observations not usable at that time.

items.explanation: Event time alone cannot establish availability. The replay may use this observation only once its declared availability permits it.
